## Support bundle

<!--
The single most useful thing you can attach. It collects the version, a
redacted config, the `unarr doctor` report, recent daemon logs and the
daemon state in one file:

    unarr support-bundle

Run `unarr support-bundle --print` first if you want to see exactly what
would go in without writing anything. Your API key, agent hash, WebDAV
credentials and NZB passwords are never included, and paths, names and URLs
are reduced to `<set>` / `<default>` rather than copied — but the bundle is
yours to inspect before you attach it.
-->
